scope: Separate metadata-only original-source reauthorization design. No interface, validator, credentials, provisioning, issuer, factory or runtime changes. Does not delay current Viewer release.

observedProblem.immutableAcquisitionReceipt: Actual closed LiDAR acquisition provenance receipt contains no expiry field. Do not describe it as an expiring receipt or reseal/change its ID/hash to refresh authority.
observedProblem.actualClient: Pinned52b7 LidarProvenanceClient authenticates metadata reads using original ValidatedGrant.token and refuses expired grant before/during/after read. verify requires exact persisted immutable receipt, usable=true, fetched age within configured freshness<=300seconds AND current time before original grant_expires.
observedProblem.longJob: A long ODM/TreeDar stage can outlive original payload transfer grant. Repeating existing fetch/verify cannot provide independent metadata refresh after expiry. Current PipelineJournal, TreeDar stage and publication recheck that verifier; no claim current implementation already solves this.
observedProblem.custody: Cached hash plus stat identity of a mutable file is not original-source custody proof. Real immutable managed custody or purge-path pins enforced by an authorized issuer remain activation gates.

encoding.policy: All fieldsets and discriminated variants closed, all listed fields required; reject unknown/missing/duplicate keys. Reuse v3 sourced UUID/slug/integer/time/hash grammars and metadata canonicalization/limits, not a new generic serialization.
encoding.selfDigests: intentSha256 and receiptSha256 each hash canonical UTF8 complete corresponding structured record with ONLY that own top-level field omitted. Nested hashes and object ordering remain included. Physical sha256 hashes exact original bytes without canonicalization. SealedStageAdmission.admissionSha256 follows same single-own-field omission.
encoding.limits: Whole metadata message<=4194304bytes, arrays<=10000, nonnegative safe integers<=9007199254740991; positive fields explicitly noted. A concrete finite ControlBudgetPolicy is committed before any issue; no unlimited fallback. Metadata history capacity counts measured canonical serialized records, exact object counts, retry attempts and ledger bytes, not an aggregate guess.
encoding.newTypeNames: ltds-original-metadata-reauthorization-v1-proposed, immutable_metadata_intent, metadata_authorization_receipt. Concrete proposed spelling is an engineering paired decision; NAS owner chooses actual storage/custody/retention authority, not JSON field spellings.

ImmutableMetadataIntent.round: positive safe integer; advance only after previous round durably resolved authorized/denied or explicitly reconciled not-issued
ImmutableMetadataIntent.planSha256: exact immutable approved full requested-stage plan digest
ImmutableMetadataIntent.stageDefinitionSha256: exact immutable next/current stage definition digest including original input and admitted engine/worker/reservation binding
ImmutableMetadataIntent.stage: v3 StageBinding, exact original continuation and admitted worker identities
ImmutableMetadataIntent.predecessorProofSha256: exact durably settled preceding-stage proof digest; null only for no predecessor under original plan
ImmutableMetadataIntent.originalAcquisition: OriginalReceiptIdentity; unchanged genuine-source provenance receipt, no new expiry or refresh ID
ImmutableMetadataIntent.originalCustody: OriginalReceiptIdentity for independently authenticated actual custody proof
ImmutableMetadataIntent.originalObjects: ASCII-sorted OriginalObject array, exact original genuine LiDAR subset under input manifest
ImmutableMetadataIntent.originalTransferDigest: exact immutable ORIGINAL transfer-grant/transfer-intent digest, never a bearer or resealed replacement
ImmutableMetadataIntent.payloadBudgetLedgerId: UNCHANGED original durable cumulative payload-byte ledger identity
ImmutableMetadataIntent.payloadBudgetLedgerRevision: observed monotonic revision, cannot reset cumulative consumed/reserved bytes
ImmutableMetadataIntent.issuerPolicySha256: exact approved issuer original-source/custody policy digest
ImmutableMetadataIntent.controlBudgetLedgerId: exact separately provisioned bounded metadata-only budget/history ledger
ImmutableMetadataIntent.controlChargeId: durable preissue charge bound to exact operation/round/intent bytes and ledger; no double charge on same-key replay
ImmutableMetadataIntent.requestedAt: canonical UTC milliseconds, immutable after persistence

OriginalReceiptIdentity.receiptSha256: hash of exact canonical original receipt bytes under its original agreed domain; no reseal
OriginalReceiptIdentity.issuerId: expected configured issuer identity, VERIFIED from authenticated channel/policy, never trusted from declaration alone
OriginalReceiptIdentity.issuerPolicySha256: exact original issuer policy digest bound to source proof

OriginalObject.sha256: exact original LAS/LAZ physical byte hash
OriginalObject.byteSize: positive safe integer exact original file bytes
OriginalObject.controlledObjectId: opaque immutable managed NAS identity verified by custody issuer, never worker/client path
OriginalObject.custodyPhysicalReceiptId: exact independently verified original physical-custody receipt

AuthorizedResponse.receiptId: globally role-distinct stable issuer receipt for this operation/round, immutable on exact replay
AuthorizedResponse.predecessorProofSha256: exact intent predecessor proof or null
AuthorizedResponse.originalObjects: exact canonical intent OriginalObject array, no subset/change
AuthorizedResponse.originalTransferDigest: exact original intent digest, not renewed transfer
AuthorizedResponse.payloadBudgetLedgerRevision: exact checked revision bound to intent; concurrent changes require reconciliation, not reset
AuthorizedResponse.issuerPolicySha256: exact requested and currently approved policy
AuthorizedResponse.authenticatedActorBindingSha256: issuer-generated digest of independently authenticated caller/worker/coordinator credential actor binding; verifier compares trusted channel identity, not caller-declared actor field
AuthorizedResponse.custodyRevision: monotonic authoritative custody state revision checked
AuthorizedResponse.revocationRevision: monotonic authoritative access/revocation state revision checked
AuthorizedResponse.metadataExpiresAt: bounded metadata-authority deadline later than checkedAt under policy; does NOT alter original acquisition/custody identity or payload expiry/budget
AuthorizedResponse.receiptSha256: canonical structured self-digest; authentication still requires trusted issuer verification

DeniedResponse.receiptId: globally role-distinct stable issuer receipt for exact operation/round
DeniedResponse.intentSha256: exact immutable request digest covering ALL parent/plan/stage/predecessor/source/transfer/budget bindings
DeniedResponse.authenticatedActorBindingSha256: trusted issuer-authenticated actor binding, not caller declaration
DeniedResponse.custodyRevision: authoritative state revision checked; 0 only if issuer explicitly cannot resolve state and denial reason is issuer_unavailable
DeniedResponse.revocationRevision: authoritative state revision checked; same unavailable constraint
DeniedResponse.metadataExpiresAt: literal null; denial grants no metadata authority
DeniedResponse.predecessorProofSha256: exact intent predecessor proof or null
DeniedResponse.originalObjects: exact canonical original intent object closure
DeniedResponse.originalTransferDigest: exact original transfer digest, no reseal
DeniedResponse.payloadBudgetLedgerRevision: exact intent observation, never resets ledger
DeniedResponse.issuerPolicySha256: exact intent requested policy; policy_changed is denial, no automatic replacement

ControlBudgetPolicy.policySha256: exact approved bounded metadata control policy digest
ControlBudgetPolicy.maxRounds: explicit positive finite safe integer per original parent
ControlBudgetPolicy.maxAttemptsPerRound: explicit positive finite safe integer including exact replay and lookup requests
ControlBudgetPolicy.maxHistoryRecords: explicit positive finite exact durable row count limit
ControlBudgetPolicy.maxHistoryBytes: explicit positive finite measured canonical record byte cap including intents,responses,lookup/retry records and receipt proofs
ControlBudgetPolicy.maxConcurrentRequests: explicit positive finite per issuer/parent limit
ControlBudgetPolicy.metadataFreshnessSeconds: explicit positive<=300 preferred inherited bound; final value paired before activation
ControlBudgetPolicy.reservedControlDiskReceiptId: actual separately enforced capacity hold for entire bounded control history/outbox coexistence

ControlJournalEntry.intentBytes: measured canonical serialized intent byte length
ControlJournalEntry.attemptCount: exact monotonically charged wire/lookup attempts; no reset on crash
ControlJournalEntry.responseReceiptId: exact verified response receipt ID or null before resolution
ControlJournalEntry.responseSha256: exact verified response structured digest or null before resolution
ControlJournalEntry.responseBytes: exact persisted canonical response bytes,0 before response
ControlJournalEntry.actorVerificationReceiptId: trusted issuer/channel actor verification receipt or null before response
ControlJournalEntry.previousRoundReceiptSha256: exact preceding resolved receipt or not-issued reconciliation evidence digest; null only round1

SealedStageAdmission.admissionSha256: canonical structured self-digest omitting only admissionSha256

authoritySeparation.metadataClient: Distinct typed metadata-only issuer client, authentication scope and durable journal; neither accept nor forward original payload transfer bearer. Fixed configured issuer route and identity, no client-selected URL, proxy/redirect or credential transfer.
authoritySeparation.noNewProvisioning: This proposal does not select/create credentials, issuer service, endpoints, permissions, secrets or storage pins. Actual authority integration and custody enforcement require paired evidence before activation.
authoritySeparation.payload: Metadata response never issues payload-read permission, raises payload byte allowance, renews expiresAt, changes reservation, replaces transfer grant or resets accounting. Original expired payload grant remains expired.
authoritySeparation.actors: Expected coordinator/worker actor derives from authenticated configured issuer/channel and original trusted plan. Caller input actor strings or self-hashed actor binding cannot authorize anything. An actor mismatch is denied even if request/source hashes match.
authoritySeparation.nextStage: Fresh authorized metadata response, exact original intent, currently valid metadata deadline AND current authoritative parent/admission/revocation state required immediately before NEXT heavy stage. Persist sealed StageAdmission linking exact receipt/intent before mutation; no stale cached success or expired original payload-token workaround.
authoritySeparation.historicalStageEvidence: Once a stage starts, its sealed at-start admission receipt and original acquisition identity remain immutable evidence through execution/result validation. Metadata TTL passage does not rewrite bundle sourceLidar/provenanceReceiptId, acquisition hash, stage intent or reauthorization IDs, nor automatically invalidate truthful past execution evidence. Any already-pinned admission/reauthorization IDs in immutable bundle/result metadata remain exact. Current native bundle v1 closed fieldset is not silently extended; new admission link is a separately versioned immutable sidecar/receipt until paired schema agreement.
authoritySeparation.currentRevocation: TTL freshness is not real revocation checking. Enforce current authenticated revocation/parent authority independently; a real revocation may hold/cancel under agreed parent policy even while a historical metadata receipt was valid. Never interpret historical admission as permission to continue all later actions.
authoritySeparation.publication: Publication requires separate CURRENT authorized publication/catalog authority and exact accepted product closure, including current revocation policy. Source metadata reauthorization or historical valid admission alone cannot publish after revocation. Publication checks must not rewrite historical bundle identity.
authoritySeparation.custody: Actual original-source retention/purge pins or immutable managed copy plus authorized issuer physical receipt remain mandatory. A current metadata hash/stat match of a mutable path cannot substitute. Source absent/replaced/unpinned is denied/held, not silently regenerated from ODM output.

durableSequence: Recover original parent/plan/stage/predecessor/acquisition/custody/source/transfer/ledger identities and prior resolved rounds. Bound plan and original source stay unchanged.

Reserve and durably charge exact bounded control intent/response/history capacity before issue; persist canonical immutable intent+digest, stable operationId/round/charge and expected actor/issuer binding. Charge retries/lookups against same finite history policy before dispatch.
Issue through distinct metadata-only authenticated issuer client. Persist issued intent before request; no original payload token and no payload budget/TTL side effect.

On transport loss or crash set outcome_unknown. Authoritatively lookup exact operationId+round+intent digest; if explicitly supported idempotence permits, replay identical ORIGINAL canonical body under same key. Different body/key or new round cannot resolve ambiguity. Never treat timeout as denial or grant.

Verify exact request/response binding, trusted issuer+actor authentication, original identities, state revisions, policy/time and capacity. Durably persist original immutable response plus actor verification and budget records before authorized use. Denied is durable no-authority; no last-green cache fallback.

New round only after prior authorized/denied or authoritative not-issued reconciliation is durable, under remaining finite budget. Do not overwrite history or roll back counters/revisions on restart. Budget/history/issuer capacity exhaustion holds before issuing more requests.

Before next stage recheck current parent/claim/admission/revocation authority and metadata freshness; seal original admission link and dispatch once. Capture stage outcome under that immutable identity. Current revoke/cancel policy is enforced separately during execution.

After actual ALL heavy execution settlement, heavy slots may release under v3 rules while disk/control/outbox/custody capacity holds remain until accepted delivery and authorized cleanup. Metadata outage does not justify deleting source/results or retaining heavy slot indefinitely after full safe settlement.

Before publication use separate current publication authority. Result acceptance verifies historical immutable source/admission binding and actual product bytes, without resealing provenance to pass expired cache checks. Cleanup/release follows exact original custody/acceptance/pin policy, not metadata TTL.

proposedTestVectors.input: Original acquisition/custody IDs unchanged; payload expired; distinct metadata issuer currently authorizes exact source
proposedTestVectors.expect: Fresh metadata receipt may authorize next-stage admission only; payload grant stays expired and cumulative byte ledger unchanged
Fails closed; no claim existing client provides new metadata-only authority

proposedTestVectors.input: Issuer commits response, network reply lost
proposedTestVectors.expect: Same operation/round/intent lookup or proven identical same-key replay; no new operation/round or extra payload budget
Reject before issue; reconcile exact prior intent first

proposedTestVectors.input: Correct body hashes but caller-declared actor differs from authenticated channel/plan
proposedTestVectors.expect: Denied; self-hashed actor declaration cannot authorize

proposedTestVectors.input: Same old receipt ID but object bytes/physical receipt/custody revision changed
proposedTestVectors.expect: Denied/hold; no rebind original receipt and no original identity replacement

proposedTestVectors.input: Valid sealed admission at start; metadata deadline later passes; actual completed products match immutable source/admission
proposedTestVectors.expect: Preserve historical admission and bundle identity; current revoke/parent policy checked separately; do not reseal source receipt

proposedTestVectors.input: Historical admission valid but current authoritative revocation denies publication
proposedTestVectors.expect: Hold publication; retain truthful result evidence/custody, no publication from old green cache

proposedTestVectors.input: Next metadata attempt would exceed exact count/byte/round/control-disk policy
proposedTestVectors.expect: Hold before issue and preserve remaining custody/outbox capacity; no budget counter reset

proposedTestVectors.input: File currently matches source SHA/stat but has no enforced immutable custody or purge pin receipt
proposedTestVectors.expect: Cannot activate or authorize next stage; hash/stat observation is not custody proof

proposedTestVectors.input: Canonical denied receipt with metadataExpiresAt:null and exact request digest
proposedTestVectors.expect: Persist denial and no authority; do not retry as a new round automatically or fall back to cached success

pairedReviewQuestions: Accept exact closed intent/authorized/denied fields and immutable round+operation semantics with inherited grammars/canonicalization?

Which actual metadata-only issuer/client authentication verifies original custody and current revocation independently from expired payload grants, without provisioning anything through this proposal?
Pair durable preissue finite control budget/history reservations, exact outcome lookup/same-key replay and actor-verification evidence; define deployed policy values before activation.

Pair next-stage current admission, historical sealed stage identity, separate ongoing revocation/cancel policy and separate publication authority so TTL refresh never rewrites original bundle lineage.
Provide actual enforced original custody/purge pin or immutable-copy evidence; cached hash/stat and matching receipt strings are insufficient.
validationClaim: Test vectors are design proposals only. No validator implemented or run, no test-pass claim, no existing client repaired or runtime enabled.
